reviews.title: Not what it seems
reviews.text: So first off you won’t be able to use this app unless you get a subscription bcuz there’s no free version of this app. They force you to pay for it by getting a subscription. Secondly when you do get a chance to go into the app which I don’t know how I was able to get into it but there’s a white search bar that is glaring out at you disturbing your view of the stars and constellations etc. it won’t go away, it’s just there in your face😠 all the time and in the way. Third, everything is kind of sketchy. And finally I was able to get into the actual app one time and all of a sudden there’s a error message that pops up saying you need a subscription to use the app, well I’m not paying one damn cent for this app. I think that if you want a really good app go over to Sky Guide they’re the best. Dont waste your time leave this app alone. Thank you to these greedy, money hungry developers. I’m deleting the app follow my lead don’t even download it

reviews.title: FREE TRIAL IS A LIE
reviews.text:
The app advertises a 3-DAY TRIAL period, but charged me $1.99 anyway. After I cancelled the subscription, I submitted a refund request with Apple support and they denied it. So it was NOT in fact a free trial. 
 
This is misleading info to bait and switch app users into signing up and should be reported and rectified.

reviews.title: Needs Some Work…
reviews.text: My issue with the app is that, you have to scan your certificate or put in information that’s needed manually. In my opinion, once you scan the QR Code or put in manually, you should have to option to save it. That way it prevents you from having to do these steps every time you open the app. I can say for me, I don’t carry the certificate nor the registration number on me at no times. I would love to be able to just open the app and look at the Star that I dedicated to my son in honor of his name whenever I want to. So maybe look into fixing that, and you might get a better rating from me.
